proposed_urls.rationale: 25 ILCS 170 Lobbyist Registration Act — leaf page; full statute body in a single act-level document.
5 ILCS 420 Art. 1 (Short Title, Definitions) — lobbyist definitions for the Governmental Ethics Act.
5 ILCS 420 Art. 2 (Restricted Activities) — lobbying-adjacent restrictions on public officials.
5 ILCS 420 Art. 3 (Code of Conduct) — official conduct rules tied to lobbyist interactions.
5 ILCS 420 Art. 3A (Governmental Appointees) — appointee disclosure obligations.
5 ILCS 420 Art. 4a (Disclosure of Economic Interests) — central statement-of-economic-interests filing regime.
5 ILCS 430 Art. 1 (General Provisions) — definitions of 'lobbyist' and 'lobbying activity'.
5 ILCS 430 Art. 5 (Ethical Conduct) — revolving-door / post-employment lobbying restrictions.
5 ILCS 430 Art. 10 (Gift Ban) — lobbyist-to-official gift prohibitions.
5 ILCS 430 Art. 20 (Executive Ethics Commission and Executive IGs) — executive-branch lobbying enforcement body.
5 ILCS 430 Art. 25 (Legislative Ethics Commission and Legislative IG) — legislative-branch lobbying enforcement body.
5 ILCS 430 Art. 50 (Penalties) — penalty schedule for ethics/lobbying violations.

notes: IL 2015 uses hyphenated `chapter-N/` slugs and `act-N-ilcs-M/` per-act TOCs (differs from the 2010 numeric-slug `chapterN/M.html` convention noted in the prior). Parallel-regime confirmed: chapter-25 holds the Lobbyist Registration Act (25 ILCS 170, a depth-3 leaf — pass-3 TSV empty); chapter-5 holds the Governmental Ethics Act (5 ILCS 420) and the State Officials and Employees Ethics Act (5 ILCS 430), both depth-4 with article-level subpages. Pass-3 article selections filter by lobbying-disclosure scope (definitions, restrictions, gift ban, disclosure of economic interests, ethics-commission enforcement, penalties) and drop pure severability / unrelated articles (whistleblower, auditor general, transit boards, retrocession, etc.). Aligns with the 2010 prior (25 ILCS 170 + 5 ILCS 420 + 5 ILCS 430) at act level.
